specs.title: the text list mode offers the same seats as the map @a11y
every route and state is free of axe violations @a11y
a seat taken by somebody else turns up on the map without a reload @realtime
a missing sequence number is detected and the client resyncs @realtime
the organizer dashboard counts the same seats the buyers see @realtime
the map is correct again after the connection is cut @realtime
a reload picks the map up where it is now, not where it was @realtime
a hold survives a reload, so refreshing does not orphan seats @realtime
a 5,000-seat map renders inside the budget @performance
a delta repaints only the rows it touches @performance
lists what is on sale @smoke
has no axe violations @a11y
the first tab stop is the skip link and it moves focus to main @keyboard
an unknown route says so rather than showing a blank page @smoke
